prompts.control_circle_pressed: Use case: stylized-concept. Create exactly ONE finished individual raster UI asset for the Roblox balloon adventure Fly High, filename control_circle_pressed.png. Reference image: use the attached UI concept sheet ONLY as a visual style reference, specifically its empty teal-and-brass circular button in row 1 column 4. Do NOT reproduce the sheet. Subject: a perfectly circular EMPTY reusable button base, pressed/held-down state. Match dark ocean teal enamel and warm brushed brass rim, shallow hand-painted game UI bevels, small evenly spaced brass rivets. Make the central teal face visibly recessed and darker than the normal reference state, with a narrow inner shadow and slightly subdued brass highlights, so the pressed state is unambiguous. Flat front-facing orthographic view, mathematically circular silhouette, consistent upper-left lighting. Canvas target 512x512 pixels, single object centered, diameter about 410 pixels, 10% transparent margin on every side. Real transparent RGBA background with clean antialiased alpha edges; absolutely no colored halo, no checkerboard baked into the file, no outer drop shadow. No icon, no arrow, no lettering, no numbers, no watermark. Keep interior empty for overlaying separate gameplay glyphs. Deliver a single isolated production button image, not a screenshot, sheet, scene, or mockup.
prompts.panel_9slice: Use case: stylized-concept. Create exactly ONE finished individual raster HUD background asset for Roblox Fly High, filename panel_9slice.png. Reference image: attached Fly High UI kit is a STYLE reference only: dark ocean teal enamel, warm restrained brushed brass edging, hand-painted adventure-game finish. Do not reproduce its icons or sheet. Subject: one EMPTY wide rectangular panel for Roblox ScaleType.Slice (9-slice). Canvas target 512x256 pixels, exact 2:1 wide aspect ratio. Straight-on orthographic UI, centered symmetric rectangle occupying 90% of canvas, transparent narrow outer margin. Modestly rounded four corners, thin continuous brass double rim with shallow bevel. Uniform very dark teal interior, deliberately low contrast so dynamic white text can be overlaid later. Crucial stretch constraints: all decorative detail confined to the four CORNERS within 48x48 pixel corner regions; straight horizontal edge strips and straight vertical edge strips must have constant thickness and smooth repeating-free color, NO rivets or ornaments in stretchable edge middles; the large middle is an even flat dark-teal fill with no texture, no grain, no radial gradient, no shine stripe. Small simple corner brass fasteners allowed only inside fixed corner caps. Clean readable premium game HUD background matching the kit but understated. No icons, no words, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no symbols, no internal separators. Real transparent RGBA OUTSIDE the rounded rectangle only, opaque teal center. No scene, no floating perspective, no drop shadow, no baked checkerboard, no colored fringe. Single production panel only.
